title: TwinsUK dry-eye gut-microbiome analysis code
description: Analysis implementations accompanying Lower gut microbiome richness is associated with more frequent dry eye symptoms: a twin study, manuscript version 49. Includes portable Python adapters, preserved Python and R source, synthetic example inputs, and aggregate reference results. Participant-level TwinsUK data require approved access. Independent assessment of the exploratory community-test assumptions remains pending; see the documented verification limits.
